section_1.title: 1. Cookies and similar technologies
section_1.p1: Cookies are small pieces of data a site stores in the browser. Similar technologies (localStorage, sessionStorage, pixels) can also store device or session identifiers.
section_1.p2: This document describes which technologies {platformName} uses, for what purposes, and on what basis. It is an information policy, not a consent to personal data processing.

section_3.title: 3. Necessary cookies and browser storage
section_3.p1: Necessary technologies are required to provide the service (sign-in session, interface language, theme, remembering your cookie choice). They run without a separate consent and cannot be turned off in the banner, otherwise the service would stop working.
list: language — selected interface language (ru or en).
platform_theme — light or dark console theme.
platform:frontend:cookie_consent — stored consent choice so this browser is not asked again.

section_4.title: 4. Analytics cookies
section_4.p1: Analytics run only after a separate consent on /consent/cookies. Yandex Metrica and Google Analytics scripts are not loaded before consent.
section_4.p2: If a Yandex Metrica id is configured, Metrica loads after consent, including Webvisor (session recording to study site usability). Metrica cookie identifiers (_ym_uid and related) and ClientID are treated as personal data under Roskomnadzor practice.
section_4.p3: If a Google Analytics id is configured, the Google tag loads after consent (_ga and related cookies). Transfer to Google LLC is a cross-border processing. The controller notifies Roskomnadzor of the cross-border transfer when this tool is enabled.

section_5.title: 5. Recipients
list: Yandex (Yandex Metrica / Webvisor) — if a Metrica id is configured.
Google LLC (Google Analytics) — if a GA id is configured.
Other processors listed in the Privacy Policy: {{cloud_provider}}, {{billing_provider}}.

section_6.title: 6. Retention
section_6.p1: Necessary cookies last for the session or until you clear the browser. Analytics cookie lifetime is set by the respective provider.
section_6.p2: The controller keeps the consent journal record for {{retention_logs}} to prove that consent was obtained (Article 9 of Federal Law No. 152-FZ).

section_7.title: 7. How to change or withdraw your choice
section_7.p1: Use “Cookie settings” in the site footer. You can keep necessary technologies only or allow analytics again.
section_7.p2: Withdrawing analytics consent stops analytics for this browser: the page reloads and analytics scripts are not attached. Necessary cookies required to sign in are not affected.

banner.title: Cookies
banner.body: We use necessary cookies so the site works. Analytics cookies (Yandex Metrica, including Webvisor, and Google Analytics if configured) run only with your consent. This is a separate consent, not part of the terms of service.
banner.body_necessary_only: We use only necessary cookies and browser storage: session, language, theme, and remembering this notice. Analytics scripts are not configured now.
banner.category_necessary_hint: Session, language, theme, stored choice. Always on.
banner.category_analytics_hint: Yandex Metrica (including Webvisor) and Google Analytics if configured on the site. You can turn this off.
